title: Assistant replies taking 20+ seconds

acceptableCauses.mechanism: The LLM provider started rejecting our calls with 429 (quota exceeded: tokens per minute, limit=200000); the orchestrator retries with backoff, so answers take 20 s+ and some fail.

partialCredit.reason: Right dependency, but misses that it is quota throttling.

requiredEvidence.description: 429 quota errors from the LLM provider

keyCounterevidence: knowledge-index p95 rose only to ~0.35 s and retrieval logs show passages returned in well under 0.5 s, which cannot explain 20 s answers.
redHerrings: past incident: assistant slow during index rebuild
